title: Nonlinear Route, Choice, Consequence & Dependency Graph
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic nonlinear route, choice, consequence and dependency-graph authoring on top of MAS-02 structure and MAS-03 assembly, while preserving explicit references, fail-closed validation and the boundary between prepared authoring semantics and live runtime/state mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared nonlinear routes, choices, consequences and dependencies inside the MAS authoring workspace without executing them as live runtime transitions or duplicating canonical Action/Event/Adventure state authority.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically express nonlinear routes, choices, consequences and dependencies over prepared MAS structure/assembly with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states, while preserving canonical owner/runtime authority and never treating the prepared graph as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 workspace/document authority, MAS-02 higher-order structure and MAS-03 prepared assembly remain foundational and were not reopened.

Routes, choices, consequence proposals and dependency relationships are prepared MAS authoring semantics only; CNI, Action/Event, Adventure and other canonical runtime owners retain execution/state/mutation authority.
Prepared route reachability, authored choices and consequence proposals never prove that a transition, choice, encounter or event occurred.
Route targets fail closed unless they resolve to MAS-02 structure nodes or MAS-03 set pieces; graph edges, choice destinations and consequence references also fail closed.
Branching, node-based, sandbox and hybrid authoring are supported without a required golden route; prepared primaryRoute remains unset and no choices/consequences are executed.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-04.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-04, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-05 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-06+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.

pre_red_profile_repair.failure: Validation Core rejected the focused profile step id before tests as invalid; deterministic evidence could not be generated because execution-result.json did not exist.
pre_red_profile_repair.repair: Shortened only the focused validation step identifier to mas04-focused-nonlinear-graph; production and acceptance behavior, scope and authority were unchanged.

plan_adjustments.summary: The first RED candidate used a focused step identifier rejected by Validation Core before test execution. The identifier alone was shortened before causal RED; no behavior, authority or tranche scope changed.

Application repository policy allowed squash merge only at publication time. PR 504 was therefore squash-merged without changing the validated head; the published merge tree exactly matches the terminal validated tree.

next_action: MAS-04 is closed. MAS-05 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
